notes.title: New chapter added！
notes.content:
We have received a lot of feedback - positive and negative - since the release of Mr. Pumpkin 2. We listened to your suggestions and as a result, decided to make a whole new chapter. And now, we are happy to bring this new chapter to you.

Thank you all for your support and criticism. Have fun and happy New Year!

What's new in 1.0.8:

1. A new chapter
	There are 2 ways to access the new chapter:
	(1) If you have already completed the game, select Continue at the main menu. Skip the first 2 cut scenes and you can play the new chapter.
	(2) If you have not completed the story, play normally and you will see the new chapter later on.
	
2. Various bug fixes and optimizations.
